proposed_capability: P141 selects a bounded, trainable 3x3 convolutional spatial pattern learner on verified five-by-five semantic floor patches; existing household navigation remains graph authoritative. Local opt-in learning uses independently observed traversal outcomes and a disjoint prequential holdout gate before exposing scored advice.
player_save_control_impact: No game/OS inputs, raw screenshots, EA game file reads, save writes, network or background scans. 3x3 convolution and bounded SGD are evaluated only on supplied semantically attested map patches with replay-safe independently reviewed outcomes. No automatic persistence; optional explicit invocation persists only hashed scoped model statistics in an existing local profile path. Player activity or stale scene refuses training; unvalidated models abstain.

strategic_theses.thesis: Deploy dense visual CNN to control Sims and camera
strategic_theses.evidence: Existing camera/SLAM seams and separately owned PR #159
strategic_theses.falsification: No host dataset, patch-aligned labels, native EA hooks or Windows live certification; overlaps independent sensor PR

strategic_theses.thesis: Build generic reinforcement-learning policy across all Sims actions
strategic_theses.evidence: Existing judgment, needs and navigation policies
strategic_theses.falsification: Unproven action/state reward ownership would bypass player sovereignty and require substantial game data

strategic_theses.thesis: Add fixed handcrafted convolution filters as an edge detector
strategic_theses.evidence: Convolutional spatial patterns from verified maps are feasible
strategic_theses.falsification: Non-learning filters add little over existing graph, cannot adapt from observed outcomes

strategic_theses.thesis: Build dependency-free trainable convolutional route-risk advisory with replay and heldout gates
strategic_theses.evidence: Existing opted-in traversal cost learner, verified passages and offline navigation planner provide labels, scope and a usable advisory seam
strategic_theses.falsification: Would be useless without independent evidence and better-than-baseline holdout loss; deny unvalidated predictions and retain fixed Dijkstra behavior

selected_thesis: Train compact convolutional filters with observed traversal labels and route through verified household planner as non-actuating advisory; no extra ML dependency, sensor takeover or native gameplay claim.
investigation: P95 compare fixed kernels vs trainable spatial filters, prototype 5x5 semantic floor patch -> 3x3 learned conv -> ReLU/mean pool -> sigmoid -> receipt; P82 test deterministic offline samples, replay/invalid input, holdout vs smoothed constant baseline, performance and fail-closed path. P08 requires local Sims runtime unavailable through GitHub provider; P07/P124 integrate only bounded code/tests/docs.
expected_outcome: A model can improve prequential route-blocked predictions on structured labeled data without changing existing verified route selection, creating edges, moving the camera/Sim or granting input; portable no-numpy CPU bounded learning and explicit local profile storage.
negative_tests: No consent or interrupted player refuses training/storage
Replaying same pre-capture under new event ID never retrains
Invalid NaN/infinite/malformed tensors or model weights denied
Heldout never trains on its own label
Until enough heldout evidence and improvement, recommendation abstains
No spatial patch preserves byte-equivalent legacy route and authority fields
No hidden desktop input, raw screen captures, uncontrolled polling or remote telemetry
No new graph edge or path authorization from prediction
No EA/gameplay certification claim from synthetic data
rollback_path: Revert isolated PR; optional bounded local model profiles may be deleted manually; no previous game data or routing schema is migrated.
unresolved_unknowns: No local Sims 4 Windows runtime or exact EA geometry source accessible from GitHub connector
PR #159 separately owns host visual sensing
Real calibration must use independent local game events under player consent
BI-002 hunger remains independently unproven at Live Mode
decision_rationale: Reuses real verified input/event contracts and testable offline seams; narrow conservative first conv capability is reversible, measurable, and orthogonal to existing native gameplay owner.
